Copies source files over same-named files in a folder, or adds the
ones the folder does not have yet.

REPLACE source [destination] [/A] [/P] [/R] [/W]
REPLACE source [destination] [/P] [/R] [/S] [/W] [/U]

  source       File or wildcard to copy from.
  destination  Folder to update (default: the current folder).
  /A           Add only the files missing from the destination.
  /P           Ask before each file.
  /R           Also overwrite read-only files.
  /S           Look for the files in every subfolder of the destination.
  /W           Wait for a key before starting.
  /U           Replace only files whose contents differ from the source.

/A cannot be combined with /S or /U.
